## Description

Decomposes non-stationary intraday price series into Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMFs) via Hilbert-Huang Transform to isolate instantaneous phase and amplitude for low-lag trend execution.

## Where it may fit

Intraday momentum transitions, choppy markets with varying oscillation frequencies.

## Vehicles

Intraday Futures Strategies, Crypto Proprietary Trading Desks.

## Required data

Tick-level or 1-minute OHLCV bar data.

## Caveats

Mode mixing artifacts at signal boundaries require end-effect smoothing filters.

- <https://github.com/lasagne/PyEMD>
